sevillaPavilionForm.justification: Cylindrical drum tower + flat multicoloured canopy on four column pairs, consistent across all three photos. The current in-repo model (octagonal wooden peaked pavilion with flag mast and glowing sphere) is wrong and must be replaced.

sevillaPavilionLantern.justification: Small conical / bell-shaped finial on the drum crown; no glowing sphere

drumTower.justification: Round tower with checkerboard base and glazed upper storeys

drumTowerBalcony.justification: Viewing balcony near the top of the drum

columnStructure.justification: Four pairs of heavy timber columns (abstracted 'tree' forms)

maltidensHusForm.justification: Angled white / silver side buildings visible around the pavilion

footprint.justification: No aerial; footprint approximate from OSM only

flagMast.justification: No flag mast visible in any photo — the current model's flag mast is invention
